newsitem.title: USA: DLJ unit to sell $275 mln of mortgage loans.
newsitem.headline: DLJ unit to sell $275 mln of mortgage loans.

text.p: Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Inc said Wednesday its real estate affiliates want to sell a $275 million mortgage loan portfolio.

The investment banker said its affiliate DLJ Mortgage Acceptance Corp repurchased the $275 million face amount of mortgage pass-through certificates in late 1994 from a group of institutional investors.
It added the certificates represent interests on mortgages on 38 multi-family properties with more than 11,000 apartment units in New York, New Jersey, Florida and Pennsylvania.
